root.name: ADME
root.subtitle: ChatGPT AI Operating System
root.description: Company mind map of current AI capabilities, workflows, skills, planned capabilities and assumed gaps.

branches.name: Client & Communications
branches.description: Client-facing communication and the first validated ADME AI workflow.

children.name: White Papers & Client Communication
children.description: Current validated workflow area.

children.name: White Paper Cycle
children.description: Project progress and previous feedback feed strategy, writing, the client meeting and the next feedback cycle.

children.name: 1. Project Progress
children.description: Engineering updates, ClickUp, Drive, milestones, risks, images and evidence.
children.note: No dedicated skill has been established. This may remain source-driven rather than becoming a skill.

children.name: 2. Previous Meeting Feedback
children.description: Carry forward client decisions, corrections, questions, commitments, priorities and open items.

children.name: 3. White Paper Strategy
children.description: Decide what changed, what matters now, what can be claimed and what the paper must achieve.

children.name: 4. White Paper Writing
children.description: Turn approved strategy and evidence into the client-facing technical narrative and Way Forward.

children.name: 5. Client Meeting
children.description: Present progress, explain direction, clarify issues and move decisions forward.

children.name: 6. Capture Client Feedback
children.description: Capture confirmed, changed, rejected, deferred, questioned and unresolved items.

branches.name: Portfolio & Web

children.name: ADME Corporate Web Management
children.description: Placeholder for company website and digital presence management if ADME decides this should become an AI-supported workflow.

ai-workflow-architect.name: AI Workflow Architect
ai-workflow-architect.does: Maps business workflows, current skills, handoffs, overlaps, gaps and future architecture.
ai-workflow-architect.note: Maintains the map. It does not perform the business work inside each category.

adme-white-paper-strategist.name: ADME White Paper Strategist
adme-white-paper-strategist.does: Controls white paper strategy, source scope, truth reset, evidence delta, Definition Brief, claims, structure and visual evidence planning.
adme-white-paper-strategist.where: White Papers & Client Communication, White Paper Strategy.

client-technical-planner.name: Client Technical Planner
client-technical-planner.does: Creates technical narratives and first drafts from client and engineering inputs, but also spans planning, source interpretation, slide planning and next actions.
client-technical-planner.where: White Paper Writing and Engineering & Technical Delivery.
client-technical-planner.note: Useful today, but broader than a clean Writer role.

adme-client-communication.name: ADME Client Communication
adme-client-communication.does: Proposed to carry forward prior client feedback, prepare meetings and capture decisions, corrections, priorities, commitments and unresolved items.
adme-client-communication.note: Candidate gap identified by the White Paper Cycle.

adme-white-paper-writer.name: ADME White Paper Writer
adme-white-paper-writer.does: Proposed focused writer that receives an approved Strategy Pack and turns it into the client-facing white paper.
adme-white-paper-writer.note: Potential target state if Client Technical Planner is narrowed or split.

minimal-editorial-visuals.name: Minimal Editorial Visuals
minimal-editorial-visuals.does: Creates premium minimal visual concepts, prompts, cover images, inline visuals and editorial technology imagery.
minimal-editorial-visuals.where: Shared Production and supporting White Papers.

indesign-professional-documents.name: InDesign Professional Documents
indesign-professional-documents.does: Creates, refines, formats and quality-checks professional InDesign documents and final PDF outputs.

docx.name: DOCX
docx.does: Creates, edits, redlines, comments on, renders and verifies DOCX files.
docx.note: Artifact skill, not a business workflow owner.

pdfs.name: PDFs
pdfs.does: Processes, edits, converts, extracts, verifies and quality-checks PDF files.

slides.name: Slides
slides.does: Builds and edits presentation decks and visual aids.
slides.where: Shared Production and engineering presentation support.

spreadsheets.name: Spreadsheets
spreadsheets.does: Creates, edits, formats and analyses XLSX, CSV and TSV files.
spreadsheets.where: Shared Production and general data workflows.

adme-quizzer.name: ADME Quizzer
adme-quizzer.does: Turns bundles of clarification and decision questions into a structured interactive intake.
adme-quizzer.where: AI System & Governance and any workflow needing structured user input.

skill-creator.name: Skill Creator
skill-creator.does: Creates, updates, validates, packages and improves reusable ChatGPT skills.
skill-creator.note: Used to build the skill system itself.

portfolio-project-manager.name: Portfolio Project Manager
portfolio-project-manager.does: Manages upstream creative development of portfolio projects, evidence, story discovery and handoff.

portfolio-webmaster.name: Portfolio Webmaster
portfolio-webmaster.does: Creates and manages portfolio content, CMS drafts, previews and approved publication.
portfolio-webmaster.note: Current portfolio production and CMS skill.

perfect-fit-super-admin.name: Perfect Fit Super Admin
perfect-fit-super-admin.does: Manages, audits, recovers, changes, tests, releases and documents The Perfect Fit ecosystem.

opportunity-assistant-manager.name: Opportunity Assistant Manager
opportunity-assistant-manager.does: Manages dedicated opportunity assistant conversations, records, communications and next actions.

roshan-job-application-workflow.name: Roshan Job Application Workflow
roshan-job-application-workflow.does: Manages end-to-end job and freelance opportunity workflows including applications, interviews, follow-ups, offers and tracking.

roshan-cover-letter.name: Roshan Cover Letter
roshan-cover-letter.does: Researches roles and employers, maps evidence and writes tailored cover letters.

indesign-cv-refiner.name: InDesign CV Refiner
indesign-cv-refiner.does: Builds, refines, formats and quality-checks CVs and resumes in Adobe InDesign.
